note: Load-order profiles for Creation Engine sessions. 'core' is what the CK authoring session AND the playable test env use. It is deliberately curated rather than maximal: every master is load time and crash surface in the CK, and the facility references only vanilla objects plus two area mods. SimSettlements 2 is excluded by decision, not by oversight -- the bunker is a small area it was never made for, and excluding it resolves the workshop-hook conflict instead of deferring it. After a load, read EditorWarnings.txt for missing masters: that is how a curated list gets corrected rather than guessed at.

core.label: PIP-MON test environment core
core.rationale: in-game defaults + patches + creation frameworks + power armour + the two area mods + vendors/companions + testing aids
